## What changes for the user

## How it was tested

## Docs

- [ ] Behaviour changed: the matching `docs/product/` file is updated (or nothing a user could notice changed)
- [ ] A choice with real alternatives was made: a record is added in `docs/decisions/`
- [ ] A plan in `docs/plans/` is done: folded into the spec and the plan file deleted
- [ ] New rules or traps for the code are in the nearest `AGENTS.md`
- [ ] New user-facing strings are in all nine `locales/*.json`
